verdict.rationale: Airwallex's first-party webhook docs require a 200 acknowledgment and give each event a stable id so retries can be handled safely. The web app lets you inspect delivery status (success, queued, failed) and re-deliver events after downtime or for debugging, which covers retries, event logs and replay. missing for 10: documentation of webhook signature verification, an explicit automatic retry schedule or policy, programmatic (API) replay, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
